item.title: 1.3.9-RC2
item.description:
## Moonlight for macOS Enhanced v1.3.9-rc.2
此版本为原生架构重建前最后一个版本。 This is the final release before the native architecture rebuild.
### RC2 Updates | RC2 更新
- 修复日志查看器重构后的本地化回退：日志模式、等级、筛选、搜索和详情统一遵循应用内中英文选择，并补齐缺失翻译（[#30](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/30)、[#44](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/pull/44)）。 Fixed log-viewer localization regressions; mode, level, filters, search, and detail views now follow the in-app language selection (#30, PR #44). - 统一手柄 Menu / Options 的长按切换规则：持续按住约 2 秒触发，两条输入路径行为一致；HID 设备也无需松手后才切换（[#45](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/pull/45)）。 Unified Menu / Options mode switching to a two-second hold across both input paths, including HID devices without waiting for release (PR #45). - 修复按住 Menu 期间修改开关留下旧计时的问题；重新开启后需先松手再开始新手势，避免短按误触切换。 Fixed stale hold state across setting changes; release is required before a new gesture can begin, preventing accidental switches. - 关闭手柄鼠标模拟或切回手柄时，释放鼠标点击并恢复 A/B 与摇杆输入，避免按钮粘滞及多余 Menu 点击；DualSense 触控板模式保持独立。 Released emulated mouse clicks and restored controller controls when leaving mouse mode, avoiding stuck buttons and unintended Menu taps while preserving independent DualSense touchpad modes. - 补齐 README 中的 DualSense、Foundation 和诊断使用说明，并明确 HDR10+ 动态元数据在 macOS 呈现链路上的保留限制。 Expanded permanent README guidance for DualSense, Foundation features, and diagnostics, and clarified HDR10+ metadata limitations on macOS.
### Highlights | 更新内容
- 重构 SwiftUI 设置界面，重新组织串流、显示、音频、键鼠、手柄和更新页面，设置搜索支持具体选项。 Reorganized SwiftUI settings and added option-level search. - 补充串流控制菜单、连接设置和诊断提示的中英文本地化（[#30](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/30)）。 Expanded Chinese and English localization across streaming controls, connection settings, and diagnostics (#30). - 改善局域网发现、本地网络权限声明与手动地址探测，首选连接地址不可用时继续检测其他已知地址（[#33](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/33)、[#35](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/35)）。 Improved LAN discovery, permission declarations, and address probing when the preferred route is unavailable (#33, #35). - 修复自由鼠标模式下，鼠标悬停或 Command-Tab 切换应用后串流窗口自动抢回焦点的问题；现在需要点击才能重新激活窗口（[#21](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/21)、[#40](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/40)）。 Fixed background stream windows stealing focus in Free Mouse mode after pointer hover or Command-Tab (#21, #40). - 修正单独 Command 键映射 Windows 键的处理，并改善 Ctrl、Shift 和快捷键翻译的释放状态（[#23](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/23)、[#37](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/37)）。 Fixed standalone Command-to-Windows-key handling and improved modifier release during shortcut translation (#23, #37). - 尝试修复锁定鼠标无法移动及控制菜单返回后失去响应的问题，调整鼠标捕获、窗口焦点与菜单之间的输入恢复处理（[#24](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/24)、[#49](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/49)）。 Attempted to fix mouse movement and menu-return stalls by refining capture and recovery (#24, #49). - 改善串流启动与原生解码处理，加入窗口内加载动画，修正 Metal 启动时的回调配置错误。 Improved stream startup and native decoding, added an in-window loading indicator, and corrected Metal startup callback configuration. - 尝试修复 macOS 12 串流启动崩溃，避免布局期间重复调整控件层级，并加入布局重入保护（[#26](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/26)）。 Attempted to fix macOS 12 stream-start crashes with layout reentry protection (#26). - 尝试修复部分手柄的映射与方向输入异常，完善手柄类型识别、映射诊断及输入暂停时的状态释放（[#25](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/25)）。DualSense 支持电量、动作、震动和灯光反馈，提供触控板透传与 Mac 风格模式，可长按 Options 切换。 Attempted to fix controller mapping and directional input issues (#25), and expanded DualSense feedback and switchable touchpad modes. - 调整 DualSense 触控板轻点、自然滚动、滚动轴锁定和松手处理，减少光标跳动。 Refined DualSense tapping, natural scrolling, axis locking, and release handling. - 新增独立的 10-bit SDR 设置与协商路径（[#22](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/22)）；尝试修复 HDR 泛白与过曝，调整色彩元数据、PQ/HLG 和画面比例处理（[#29](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/29)）。按所选渲染器显示适用设置。 Added explicit 10-bit SDR negotiation (#22) and attempted to fix washed-out or overexposed HDR output (#29). - 增加 Foundation 显示器和虚拟显示器配置，改善文本及图片剪贴板协议兼容性；已完成 Foundation 剪贴板互通验证（[#32](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/32)）。 Added Foundation display configuration and improved clipboard compatibility, with text/image synchronization verified (#32). - 增加性能诊断和报告导出，提供帧率、1% low、网络及帧呈现抖动、丢帧和音频欠载数据，尝试改善流畅度与统计异常（[#31](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/31)）。 Improved native decoding and diagnostics to address smoothness and frame-statistics anomalies (#31). - 接入 Sparkle 更新界面与测试版渠道。更新优先使用 GitHub，下载失败时尝试同版本的 CNB 镜像，并继续验证更新包签名。 Integrated Sparkle and a beta channel, with GitHub-first downloads and an identical signed CNB archive fallback. - 修正自定义分辨率输入及码率设置范围，使用独立应用身份以支持与 QT 版本共存（[#41](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/41)）。 Corrected custom resolution and bitrate controls and isolated the app identity for coexistence with QT clients (#41).
- 尝试修复 DNF 中的方向键失灵，调整快捷键翻译与修饰键状态处理，避免错误吞键（[#39](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/39)）。 Attempted to fix DNF arrow-key input by refining shortcut translation and modifier-state handling (#39).
### Release Candidate | 候选版本说明
- 本候选版请从发布页手动下载安装；应用内自动更新渠道正在部署。 Download and install this candidate manually from the release page; the in-app update feed is being prepared.
- 这是预发布版本。欢迎通过对应 issue 反馈使用情况；仍然遇到同类问题时，请附上系统版本、主机版本、输入设备及日志。 This is a prerelease. If an issue persists, include your OS, host version, input device, and logs in the corresponding report. - Dolby Vision 8.1/8.4 与 HDR10+ 提供能力探测、适配和安全回退；最终输出受系统、硬件和显示链路影响。HDR Vivid 当前不可用。 Dolby Vision 8.1/8.4 and HDR10+ provide capability probing, integration, and safe fallback. Output depends on the system, hardware, and display path. HDR Vivid is unavailable. - USB 转发和主机文件为实验性能力，需要支持并启用对应功能的 Foundation Sunshine。主机文件为只读访问，Finder 挂载还需要支持相应 App Group 的签名版本。 USB forwarding and Host Files are experimental and require the corresponding Foundation Sunshine features. Host Files is read-only; Finder mounting also requires a signed build supporting the required App Group.
### Download | 下载 - 下载文件：`Moonlight-macOS-Enhanced-universal.dmg`（Apple Silicon + Intel (universal, recommended if unsure)） Download: `Moonlight-macOS-Enhanced-universal.dmg` (Apple Silicon + Intel (universal, recommended if unsure)). - 下载文件：`Moonlight-macOS-Enhanced-arm64.dmg`（Apple Silicon (arm64)） Download: `Moonlight-macOS-Enhanced-arm64.dmg` (Apple Silicon (arm64)). - 下载文件：`Moonlight-macOS-Enhanced-x86_64.dmg`（Intel Mac (x86_64)） Download: `Moonlight-macOS-Enhanced-x86_64.dmg` (Intel Mac (x86_64)).
### First Launch | 首次启动 1. 如果你不确定三者的区别，默认推荐下载 `Moonlight-macOS-Enhanced-universal.dmg`；如果你清楚自己的机型，再按需选择 `arm64` 或 `x86_64`。 If you are not sure which variant to use, start with `Moonlight-macOS-Enhanced-universal.dmg`. If you know your Mac architecture, you can choose `arm64` or `x86_64` directly. 2. 打开对应 DMG，并将 Moonlight 拖到 `Applications`。 Open the DMG and drag Moonlight to `Applications`. 3. 先正常打开一次应用。 Try opening the app normally first. 4. 如果 macOS 阻止打开，可右键应用选择“打开”，或前往 `System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway`。 If macOS blocks it, right-click the app and choose `Open`, or go to `System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway`.
### If macOS says the app is damaged | 如果 macOS 提示“应用已损坏” - 这通常表示 Gatekeeper 拦截了未公证版本，并不一定是下载文件真的损坏。 This usually means Gatekeeper blocked a non-notarized build; it does not necessarily mean the download is corrupted. - 可在终端运行以下命令： Run this command in Terminal: ```bash xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/MoonlightEnhanced.app ``` - 执行后重新打开应用。 Launch the app again after the command finishes. - 不知道怎么打开终端？按 `⌘ Space`，输入 `Terminal`，回车即可。 To open Terminal, press `⌘ Space`, type `Terminal`, and press `Enter`.
